_help: Copy this file, rename it, and edit. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Delete any meter, rule, milestone or influence you don't need. Import it from the Runebook drawer or edit it in the in-app JSON editor.
name: My Tracker

meters._help: type: bar | pips | number. min/max/start optional. decay: after N messages with no change, add amount. Look (all optional): icon (emoji or 'fa-solid fa-heart'), color, style ('bar' or 'slider') for bars, pip ('circle','heart','star','square') for pips.
meters.name: Mood

rules._help: Use keywords (whole words, any match) and/or regex. conditions supports all/any/not arrays of text or meter comparisons. cooldown is the number of subsequent non-system chat messages. event is an optional event name. aiCondition is optional and requires AI-assisted mode. Use exactly one of change or set.
rules.name: Kind words
Sincere apology
rules.aiCondition: The message contains a sincere apology, not merely the word 'sorry'.

milestones._help: Fires when a meter crosses at. direction: up, down, or either. One fire per chat by default; set repeat to true to fire on every crossing.
milestones.name: Mood high

influences._help: min/max inclusive, default to full range. status, text (sent to the AI), description (shown on screen), color (overrides the meter color) - give at least one of status/text/description. {{char}} and {{user}} work in text.
influences.description: Player-facing note shown on screen only (not sent to the AI).
